_doc: training: defaults of the GNN model card's training hyperparameters (the GNN model card overrides them).
simulations, compute, paths: not part of the network; a site settings file

_doc.directories: glob patterns of GRANDroot simulation directories
_doc.trace_files: glob, in each directory, of the files holding the traces (name the level: L0 / L1)
_doc.trace_tree: their tree: tadc (ADC counts) or tvoltage (µV, converted to ADC)
_doc.time_files: glob of the files giving du_seconds / du_nanoseconds of each trace
_doc.truth_angle_unit: unit of the tshower zenith / azimuth in these files
_doc.max_du_id: keep du_id < max_du_id (277: GP300 only); null keeps all
_doc.validation_modulo: [m, [r...]]: validation if event_number % m is one of r
_doc.augment: time_jitter_ns: Gaussian jitter of the trace start times; gain_smearing: relative Gaussian smearing of each antenna's gain; noise: {"provider": "module:function", "kwargs": {}}, see augment.py

_doc.phases: [epochs, learning rate] phases, as in the GNN codes' train_model.py
_doc.patience: stop after this many epochs without validation improvement; null: run every epoch
_doc.max_train_events: use at most this many training graphs; null: all
_doc.max_val_events: use at most this many validation graphs; null: all
_doc.keep: the state saved: best (lowest validation loss) or last (end of the last phase)

_doc.num_threads: torch CPU threads; null leaves torch's default

_doc.datasets_dir: formatted datasets, one directory per (inputs, simulations): shared by the GNN model cards that need the same graphs
_doc.models_dir: exported networks, <models_dir>/<name>/<version>/ as grand reads them
_doc.relative: relative paths are relative to the current directory
